---
title: "Clockwork"
---

Clockwork (<https://www.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/pmc/articles/PMC9363010/>) is capable of several tasks (<https://github.com/iqbal-lab-org/clockwork/wiki#pipelines-overview>), but we use it only for **variant calling** (<https://www.ebi.ac.uk/training/online/courses/human-genetic-variation-introduction/variant-identification-and-analysis/>) as part of the mycobacteria pipeline. We configure clockwork **not to **remove unwanted reads or to trim reads. No mask is used. Key outputs are Variant Calling Format (VCF) files (<https://gatk.broadinstitute.org/hc/en-us/articles/360035531692-VCF-Variant-Call-Format>) which list the location of variations from the reference genome and the evidence to support those variant calls.

# Variant calling process

- Reads are mapped to a reference genome using minimap2 (<https://github.com/lh3/minimap2>)
- SAMTools (<https://github.com/samtools/samtools>) removes duplicates (these are PCR duplicates - sometimes fragments get duplicated by PCR much more they should) → outputs a **sorted indexed bam** file
- Variants are called independently by:
    - SAMTools sensitive for SNPs (using `mpileup` command - **sorted indexed bam** as input) → outputs a **vcf** file
    - Cortex high-specificity, lower sensitivity for SNPs and good at indels (**sorted indexed bam** as input, but could alternatively use fastq files) → outputs a **vcf** file
- Using vcf files from SAMTools and Cortex, as well as the read fastq files, Minos (<https://github.com/iqbal-lab-org/minos>) adjudicates and creates a vcf file containing only the called variants → outputs a **vcf** file
- Clockwork creates a gVCF using the vcf file from Minos, filling missing positions using the vcf file from SAMTools → outputs a **vcf** file (final)

A **FASTA **file representing the assembled genome is also produced (from data generated by samtools and minos), but this is somewhat a side effect of the main task of variant calling.

# Thresholds

Software developed by close collaborators. Any relevant information on thresholds can be found in the Clockwork readme. Clockwork version can be found by checking poller release information for the deployed version e.g. <https://github.com/GlobalPathogenAnalysisService/gpas-poller/releases/tag/1.23.16> 

Specifically overridden from default:

- MIN\_DP = 3
